findings.title: Compliance sentence overstates pre-authentication protections
findings.description: Why / Context, the compliance sentence: "inventoried with the secret it already requires" is false for register and password-reset/request, and the manifest test proves membership, not the cited gates.
findings.suggested_action: Distinguish routes protected by an independent secret from routes safe because they carry no credential.

findings.title: G3 contradicts the intentional console failure-state change
findings.description: G3 still promises no user-visible change, but the pass-3 qualification introduced a deliberate console failure state; the qualification reached the use case but not G3.
